title: Potbot published identity descriptor v2
description: Published raw base Ed25519 verification key and its stable SHA-256 fingerprint. Private key material and chain codes are excluded.
$comment: The verifier computes SHA-256 over exactly the 32 raw public-key bytes and compares both signer_hash and its independently trusted expected identity. A descriptor or a self-signature cannot establish that initial identity trust. syn and synny type aliases have one identity. New output uses synny.

public_key.description: Exactly 32 raw Ed25519 public-key bytes in canonical padded standard Base64.
